title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies - Word Choice
subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

A comprehensive peace treaty was signed by the neighboring nations to ensure the peaceful ________ of their culturally diverse border communities.
questions.explain: 'Coexistence' is the state of living together in harmony or at the same time despite differing beliefs or backgrounds, a core concept in Peace Education.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

To proactively combat sexually transmitted diseases, the community health clinic initiated a free, confidential ________ program for adolescents to detect early infections.
questions.explain: In health contexts, a 'screening' program involves testing people for a disease or condition before they display noticeable symptoms.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Environmental experts universally suggest that actively transitioning to ________ energy sources like solar and wind power will drastically reduce the nation's carbon footprint.
questions.explain: Energy generated from natural resources such as sunlight, wind, or rain—which are naturally replenished—is correctly termed 'renewable' energy.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

According to global food safety guidelines, maintaining the strict ________ of raw poultry from freshly cooked foods is mandatory to prevent lethal cross-contamination.
questions.explain: In food hygiene practices, 'separation' (or segregating) is the mandatory act of keeping raw meats strictly apart from ready-to-eat foods to systematically halt the dangerous spread of bacteria.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The highly reputable electoral observer commission heavily insisted that for massive democratic elections to legitimately be heralded as fully free and totally fair, they profoundly must be systematically stripped of any violent voter ________.
questions.explain: 'Voter intimidation' constitutes attempting to illicitly sway an electorate's voting behavior through severe threats, intense fear, or harsh coercion; it strictly breaches core democratic and national values.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies
